caption: The drawing depicts an iron trivet with three legs, shown in three different views: a perspective view in the bottom right, a top-down view in the upper left, and a side view in the middle left. The trivet is predominantly triangular in shape with rounded corners and features a handle with a circular hole at one end. The surface within the triangular frame is decorated with ornate scrollwork and curly shapes. The object appears to be colored in shades of black and grey, rendered with pencil or graphite on a cream-colored background. The composition includes a scale bar beneath the side view, indicating measurements in inches. In the lower left corner of the border, the name "HOLGER HANSEN" is inscribed. The drawing is enclosed in a fine, double-lined rectangular border.
title: Flat Iron Holder
